name: Railroad Rummy
storyline:
Gather around the table for a timeless card game shaped by long nights under the stars. This is a game I played all through my teenage years while camping with friends and family, passing hands back and forth by lantern light, learning every bluff, risky draw, and last-second comeback from the people around me. Bringing it to Steam is my way of sharing that same experience with everyone, so more players can discover the laughter, tension, and unforgettable stories that make a great card game stay with you for years.

Whether you are chasing the perfect hand, reading your opponents, or making a bold play at exactly the right moment, every round is about more than just winning. It is about the rhythm of the table, the friendly competition, and the kind of game that becomes a tradition. Easy to learn and rewarding to master, this is a card game built for casual nights, fierce rematches, and the simple joy of playing together.

Multiplayer is at its best when everyone is in a voice chat, recreating that feeling of sitting around the same table, talking through every close call, big play, and dramatic finish. The conversation, reactions, and shared energy are a big part of what makes the experience special, just like it was around the campsite.
summary: A classic multiplayer rummy card game where you draw, discard, build winning hands, and outplay friends and family in tense, easy-to-learn matches inspired by real camping table traditions.
